days.warmup: 5–10 minutes of light cardio, joint circles and dynamic mobility for the muscles you are about to train.

exercises.name: Cable Crossover
exercises.instructions: Set both pulleys at the same height. Step forward so the cables are under light tension even at the start. With a soft elbow bend, bring the handles together in front of your chest in an arc.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep your core braced and spine neutral in the staggered stance.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set the safety pins or ask for a spot before you unrack any working weight. Lower the bar slowly to your mid-chest with elbows at about 45° from your body. Touch the chest lightly — do not bounce the bar.
exercises.safetyTip: Learn proper technique from a qualified trainer before performing this exercise independently.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Keep the elbows high and pointing forward, close to your ears. Extend the arms until they are straight overhead. Squeeze the triceps at full lockout.
exercises.safetyTip: Brace the core to protect the lower back in the hinged position.

exercises.name: Smith Machine
exercises.instructions: Set the safety stops at a height just below your bottom position. Stand with feet slightly forward of the bar line. Descend until the thighs are parallel or lower.
exercises.safetyTip: Always set the safety stops before you unrack.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel about a metre from the stack with the rope by your ears. Keep the hips fixed — the crunch happens only in the spine. Curl the ribs toward the pelvis, exhaling fully.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the arms passive — they only hold the rope in place.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Stand tall with a soft bend in the elbow. Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height in a smooth arc. Keep the wrist neutral — the cable does the work, not the hand.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the shoulder down and away from the ear throughout.

days.warmup: 5–10 minutes of light cardio, joint circles and dynamic mobility for the muscles you are about to train.

exercises.name: Assisted Pull-Up
exercises.instructions: Select an assist level that lets you complete every rep with good form. Start from a full hang with the chest up. Pull until your chin reaches bar height.
exercises.safetyTip: Grip firmly and step off the platform carefully after the set.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Adjust the thigh pads so you stay seated during the pull. Grip the bar just wider than shoulder width. Lean back slightly, keep the chest up, and pull the bar to your upper chest.
exercises.safetyTip: Always pull to the front of the chest, never behind the neck.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.instructions: Stand close enough that the cable is taut at the bottom. Curl the bar to your shoulders without moving the elbows. Squeeze the biceps at the top for one second.
exercises.safetyTip: Elbows stay pinned — if they move, the shoulders take over.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.instructions: Keep your body in one straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to just above the floor and press back up. Lower to the knees if needed.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the core braced so the hips never sag.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.instructions: The stroke order is: legs → body → arms. Drive with the legs first while the arms stay straight. Lean back slightly as the legs finish, then pull the handle to your ribs.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the back straight — the power comes from the legs.

exercises.name: Back Extension Bench
exercises.instructions: Set the pad so your hips can hinge freely. Start with the body in one straight line from head to heels. Lower slowly by hinging at the hips until you feel a hamstring stretch.
exercises.safetyTip: Never swing or bounce — every rep should be slow and controlled.

days.warmup: 5–10 minutes of light cardio, joint circles and dynamic mobility for the muscles you are about to train.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.instructions: Step forward and lower the back knee toward the floor, then push off the front foot into the next step. Keep the torso upright.
exercises.safetyTip: Take a long enough step that the front knee stays over the ankle.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.instructions: Hold a dumbbell or kettlebell against your chest and squat between your knees, keeping the chest proud. The front load teaches perfect squat posture.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the weight close to the chest; if the torso folds, go lighter.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees stay at about 90° at the bottom. Lower the platform until your knees approach your chest without the hips rolling up. Keep your knees tracking in line with your toes.
exercises.safetyTip: Never fully lock and snap the knees.

exercises.name: Cross Trainer
exercises.instructions: Start pedalling to wake the console, then choose your programme. Keep a tall posture with a light grip on the handles. Push and pull the handles to involve the upper body.
exercises.safetyTip: Use the step platforms when getting on and off.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.instructions: From a high plank, drive one knee toward the chest and switch legs quickly, as if running in place. Keep the hips low.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the shoulders over the wrists and the core braced.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Set the bench angle to 30–45° — steeper angles shift work to the shoulders. Lower the bar under control to just below your collarbone. Pause for a moment without bouncing.
exercises.safetyTip: Use a spotter or safety pins on heavy sets.

days.warmup: 5–10 minutes of light cardio, joint circles and dynamic mobility for the muscles you are about to train.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.instructions: Sit with knees bent and lean back slightly, keeping the back straight. Rotate the torso side to side, touching the floor beside each hip.
exercises.safetyTip: Rotate from the torso, not the arms; keep the spine long.

exercises.name: Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight. Raise the legs to vertical using the lower abs, then lower slowly without arching the back.
exercises.safetyTip: Stop lowering when the lower back starts to lift off the floor.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line. Squeeze the glutes and abs; hold the position without letting the hips sag.
exercises.safetyTip: Stop if your lower back starts to sag — form ends the set, not the clock.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Set the seat height so the handles start at ear level. Press the handles overhead until the arms are extended but not locked hard. Keep your lower back against the pad — no arching.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the back flat on the pad — if it leaves the pad, reduce the weight.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, chest up. Sit down and back until the thighs are parallel, then stand. Perfect this before adding any load.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the knees tracking over the toes.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Grip the rope or bar with the elbows glued to your ribs. Push down until the arms are fully extended. Split the rope ends apart at the bottom if using a rope.
exercises.safetyTip: Stand tall; if you must lean, the weight is too heavy.

days.warmup: 5–10 minutes of light cardio, joint circles and dynamic mobility for the muscles you are about to train.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Sit tall with a neutral spine and soft knees. Pull the handle toward your lower ribs. Squeeze the shoulder blades together at the end of the pull.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the lower back neutral throughout — brace as if someone might push you.

exercises.name: Biceps Curl Machine
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat so your elbows align with the machine pivot. Curl the handles up until the biceps are fully contracted. Squeeze hard for one second at the top.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the wrists straight — curling the wrists shifts stress to the forearms.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles align with your mid-chest. Select an appropriate resistance. Position your back against the pad and plant your feet.
exercises.safetyTip: Use an appropriate resistance and stop if you experience sharp pain, dizziness, or unusual symptoms.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise Machine
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat so the machine pivot aligns with your shoulder joint. Raise your upper arms out to the sides until they are level with your shoulders. Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
exercises.safetyTip: Stop at shoulder height — higher turns it into a trap shrug and stresses the joint.

exercises.name: Squat Rack
exercises.instructions: Set the safety pins just below your bottom position. Brace your core as if preparing to be pushed. Sit down and back, keeping your chest proud and knees tracking over the toes.
exercises.safetyTip: Learn proper technique from a qualified trainer before performing this exercise independently.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.instructions: Squat down, place the hands on the floor, kick the feet back to a plank, return the feet in, and jump up. Step instead of jumping if needed.
exercises.safetyTip: Land softly and keep the core braced. Scale to a "step-back burpee" at any time.

days.warmup: 5–10 minutes of light cardio, joint circles and dynamic mobility for the muscles you are about to train.

exercises.name: Stair Climber
exercises.instructions: Start at a slow speed to find your rhythm. Stand tall — do not lean your weight on the handrails. Place the whole foot on each step, not just the toes.
exercises.safetyTip: Hold the rails if you feel unsteady — safety first.

exercises.name: Treadmill
exercises.instructions: Always start at a slow speed and step on carefully. Walk or jog with a tall posture — no leaning on the handrails. Gradually increase speed or incline to your target intensity.
exercises.safetyTip: Use the emergency stop clip.

exercises.name: Exercise Bike
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat height first — a slight knee bend at the bottom. Pedal at a comfortable cadence for a 3-minute warm-up. Build to your target resistance and pace.
exercises.safetyTip: Check the pedals are secure before riding.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.instructions: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the pivot point of the machine. Grip the handles for stability. Extend your legs until they are straight, squeezing the quads.
exercises.safetyTip: If you have a history of knee issues, consult a qualified professional before adding load.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Align your knees with the machine pivot. Grip the handles and press your hips down into the pad. Curl the pad toward your glutes in a smooth arc.
exercises.safetyTip: Aim for the hamstrings to cramp-squeeze — not the lower back.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent. Curl the shoulders off the floor using the abs — the lower back stays on the ground. Lower slowly.
exercises.safetyTip: Keep the hands light behind the head; never pull on the neck.
